mechanics.claim: Master Yi vanishes and is unable to act during Alpha Strike, becoming targetable/interactable again only after reappearing.
Alpha Strike's primary damage instance applies only after Master Yi reappears from the vanish, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: ''Alpha Strike's'' primary damage applies after '''Master Yi''' reappears.

mechanics.claim: Marks after the first on the same target detonate instantly upon application rather than waiting for the final reappearance.
mechanics.quote: Marks after the first on the same target instead detonate instantly upon application to deal {{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:l}}*100}}}}% damage

mechanics.claim: Alpha Strike's damage is calculated at the moment each mark is placed, so damage can vary if AD changes between marks.
mechanics.quote: ''Alpha Strike's'' damage is calculated at the moment that each mark is placed.

mechanics.claim: Only the first instance of Alpha Strike's damage counts as a hit for on-hit-triggered effects like Electrocute and Eclipse.
mechanics.quote: Only the first instance of damage counts as a hit for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}} and {{iis|Eclipse}}

mechanics.claim: Alpha Strike does not grant its own on-hit cooldown reduction nor a stack of Double Strike when it applies on-hit effects.
mechanics.quote: Alpha Strike does not trigger its cooldown reduction nor grant a stack of {{ai|Double Strike|Master Yi}} when applying on-hit effects.

mechanics.claim: A single spell shield only blocks one instance of Alpha Strike's damage, not all of its hits.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a single instance of damage.

mechanics.claim: Wuju Style and Highlander can be cast during Alpha Strike, and each Alpha Strike hit refreshes their current durations.
mechanics.quote: Each time Alpha Strike hits a target, the '''current''' durations of {{ai|Wuju Style|Master Yi}} and {{ai|Highlander|Master Yi}} are refreshed.

mechanics.claim: Alpha Strike's cooldown starts counting down on cast, not on completion.
